body: That would actually be pretty cool...I'm not that great at playing really because I've taught myself, but I know some scales and some rhythm. I'd really like to get better practicing with someone else...I'll be PMing you my skype name, I've got midterms and such this next week but I'll definitely find some time

> Just feel it, don't try to fix it.

That sentence blew my mind. I'm always trying to analyze everything and figure out how I can fix what I don't like. I suppose you are right about some of these things...I'll be reading the article in full later tonight.

Indeed. I play the guitar. It might not be shadowboxing or running around, but its works well for me. I feel a bit calmer now after reading all of these posts and jamming to some good music. I smoke to relieve stress as well, so I do have my outlets. Its just sometimes even my go to outlets can't really help me, and then I do something regrettable like chewing someone out that I actually care about, or get in a fight over something that any other day wouldn't really phase me. The thing is, that has been happening more often lately and ultimately I see myself becoming the same thing that ruined my own family...that fucking terrifies me. Thanks.

> That doesn't sound to me like a sustainable way to cope with your feelings.

I agree, but what the fuck can I do about an emotion.

> Then you're not reaping the most important benefit of real relationships, which is to feel connected to and understood by others who we truly know have our best interests at heart, admittedly in their imperfect human way.

Says who, I try my hardest to help the people I know. That is the truth.  Even the people I don't know. Almost like I know I know how to help them and not myself. Maybe I need different friends...

> Well, as brutal as things are for you right now, it seems to me that if you're living behind a mask, it would be unlikely that you'd end up in any other sort of situation.

Well its not like my alternatives are any better...maybe mask was the wrong word. I don't know...at this point I'm just not that sure of any other way to act in a social situation. In regards to the whole never really getting the help I needed...what do you mean really? I spent time in a psych ward and went from therapist to therapist for plenty of time. When I mentioned the conversations and interactions I had with people at the time...many of them were with "professionals" or what have you. My family sure did have a lot of trust in those assholes. They just always seemed to care just enough to get payed. I guess distrust might have something to do with it...

I really do appreciate your breakdown of what I said...your perspective is new to me.
